an8.14:1.1: Aṭṭha ca bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅke desessāmi aṭṭha ca assadose aṭṭha ca purisakhaḷuṅke aṭṭha ca purisadose,
an8.14:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an8.14:1.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.14:2.1: Katame ca bhikkhave aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā?
an8.14:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ paṭivatteti.
an8.14:2.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghi pati kubbaraṃ hanti tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati.
an8.14:3.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati.
an8.14:4.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti.
an8.14:5.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅgheti purimaṃ kāyaṃ, paggaṇhāti purime pāde.
an8.14:6.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodaṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ viddhaṃsitvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati.
an8.14:7.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati, tatth' eva khīlaṭṭhāyi ṭhito hoti.
an8.14:8.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā tatth' eva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati.
an8.14:9.2: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:9.4: Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā. 10.
an8.14:10.1: Katame ca bhikkhave attha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā?
an8.14:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:10.3: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno ‘na sarāmi na sarāmī' ti asatiyā 'va nibbeṭheti.
an8.14:10.4: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ paṭivatteti,
an8.14:10.6: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:11.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakaṃ yeva paṭippharati
an8.14:11.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa avyattassa bhaṇitena,
an8.14:11.4: tvaṃ pi nāma bhaṇitabbaṃ maññasī' ti?
an8.14:11.5: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghi pati kubbaraṃ hanti tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati,
an8.14:11.7: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:12.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakass' eva paccāropeti
an8.14:12.3: ‘tvaṃ pi kho 'si itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī' ti.
an8.14:12.4: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati,
an8.14:12.6: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:13.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:13.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an8.14:13.3: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti,
an8.14:13.5: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:14.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno saṅghamajjhe bāhāvikkhepaṃ bhaṇati.
an8.14:14.3: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅgheti purimaṃ kāyaṃ, paggaṇhāti purime pāde,
an8.14:14.5: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:15.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:15.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno anādiyitvā saṅghaṃ anādiyitvā codakaṃ sāpattiko va yenakāmaṃ pakkamati.
an8.14:15.3: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodaṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ viddhaṃsitvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati,
an8.14:15.5: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:16.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:16.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno ‘nevāhaṃ āpanno 'mhi, na panāhaṃ āpanno 'mhī' ti. So tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheseti.
an8.14:16.3: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati, tatth' eva khīlaṭṭhāyiṭhito hoti,
an8.14:16.5: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:17.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:17.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evam āha:
an8.14:17.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi vyāvaṭā yāva idānāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī' ti?
an8.14:17.4: So sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā evam āha:
an8.14:17.5: ‘idāni kho tumhe āyasmanto attamanā hothā' ti.
an8.14:17.6: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave assakhaḷuṅko pehī ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā tatth' eva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati,
an8.14:17.8: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko hoti.
an8.14:17.10: Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā ti. 1.
